title: COMMUNICATION FROM THE CITY ENGINEER relative to initiating vacation proceedings for portions of the northerly side of College Street between Yale Street…
text:
[Council File 26-1529; CD 1]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
COMMUNICATION FROM THE CITY ENGINEER relative to initiating vacation proceedings for portions of the northerly side of College Street between Yale Street and Hill Street (VAC-E1401473).
Recommendation(s) for Council action:
1. ADOPT the City Engineer report dated October 20, 2026, attached to the Council file, to initiate the proceedings to vacate portions of the northerly side of College Street between Yale Street and Hill Street, as shown on Exhibit A of said City Engineer report, pursuant to California Streets and Highways Code, Division 9, Part 3, Public Streets, Highways and Service Easements Vacation Law.
2. DIRECT the Bureau of Engineering to investigate and report regarding the feasibility of this vacation request.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The City Engineer reports that a deposit of $14,980 was paid by the petitioner for the investigation of this request pursuant to Section 7.42 of the Los Angeles Administrative Code (LAAC). Any deficit fee to recover the cost pursuant to LAAC Section 7.44 will be required of the petitioner.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
